## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Validation

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] `python -m compileall pluginmatrix tests ci-fixtures/build_fixtures.py`
- [ ] Runtime/verdict changes include focused state tests and relevant real-Paper evidence, or explain why not.
- [ ] CLI commands, report fields, examples, and documentation remain consistent.
